name: CMF Watch Pro 2 & Apple Health Integration Guide

auto_triggers.steps_10k: Triggered when steps >= 10,000 (or user configured stepsGoal)
auto_triggers.gym_workout: Triggered when gymWorkoutDone is true (from Sept 5th onwards)

ios_shortcuts_setup: 1. Open the iOS Shortcuts App on iPhone.
2. Create a new Automation running Daily at 10:00 PM.
3. Add action 'Find Health Samples where Type is Steps, Date is Today' -> Sum values.
4. Add action 'Find Health Samples where Type is Sleep Analysis' -> Calculate Total Minutes.
5. Add action 'Get Contents of URL' with Method: POST, Headers: Content-Type: application/json.
6. Request Body JSON: { 'date': Current Date (yyyy-MM-dd), 'steps': Steps Sum, 'sleepMinutes': Sleep Mins, 'gymWorkoutDone': true }
